body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Bowers & Wilkins revealed its all-new model to experience the Bowers & Wilkins sound system in the 2009 Jaguar XKR at 2009 CES.

There's a new and improved high-performance, high-style model in the XT Series. This new model is destined to sit at the front of countless home theater systems where discerning users demand that their surround system looks as good as it sounds. Bowers & Wilkins' flagship Nautilus loudspeaker is also on display.
